# Xuanbao Industrial Emission Control Knowledge Center

> Technical documentation by Yancheng Xuanbao Environmental Technology Co., Ltd.
> Structured as six pillar guides with supporting cluster articles: SCR DeNOx,
> CO oxidation, VOC catalytic oxidation, zeolite molecular sieves, activated
> carbon and VOC treatment engineering. Main site: xuanbaoenvironment.com.

## Pillar guides

- [SCR DeNOx: The Complete Guide](https://data.xuanbaoenvironment.com/scr-denox/): chemistry, plate vs honeycomb, parameters, poisoning, regeneration, replacement.
- [CO Oxidation: The Complete Guide](https://data.xuanbaoenvironment.com/co-oxidation/): catalyst families, light-off, application scenarios.
- [VOC Catalytic Oxidation: The Complete Guide](https://data.xuanbaoenvironment.com/voc-catalysts/): Pt/Pt-Pd/non-precious systems, deactivation, lifecycle, space velocity.
- [Zeolite Molecular Sieves: The Complete Guide](https://data.xuanbaoenvironment.com/molecular-sieves/): type selection, regeneration, concentration wheels.
- [Activated Carbon: The Complete Guide](https://data.xuanbaoenvironment.com/activated-carbon/): quality indicators, fire safety, replacement cycles.
- [VOC Treatment Engineering: The Complete Guide](https://data.xuanbaoenvironment.com/voc-engineering/): technology comparison, bed design, RCO vs RTO.
